claim: Actual arbitrary predictable-coefficient conditional exponential transfer and actual probability-mixture regression supermartingale
review_kind: Separate-agent raw-source review within the same collaborative model session, not independent external refereeing.
reviewer_authorship: Reviewer authored neither ConditionalRandomMultiplier nor RegressionExponential. Reviewer authored the imported deterministic RegressionGeometry dependency and the separate Gaussian/regression cap; that dependency authorship is disclosed.

claim_card.hypotheses: An arbitrary measurable probability sample space, a conditioning sigma algebra below the ambient one, an actual measurable noise X with actual integrable exponentials for each deterministic real h and actual ordinary conditional-exponential bound. A random coefficient and nonnegative integrable weight are conditioning-measurable. The sequential application uses predictable design coordinates, next-level recorded noise, and actual conditional noise structures at each time. A generic mixing law is an actual probability measure and the process family is jointly measurable.
claim_card.conclusion: The normalized exponential at an arbitrary predictable coefficient is integrable and has actual CE<=1. Multiplication by arbitrary nonnegative integrable predictable weights preserves integrability and the actual integral/set-integral budget. The literal finite regression product is an actual nonnegative Supermartingale and equals the exact score/Gram exponential. Its literal integral under a fixed probability mixing law is an actual Supermartingale, with joint integrability and Fubini hypotheses derived.
claim_card.scope: No sample-space Standard Borel hypothesis, conditional-distribution kernel, uniform all-real-coefficient null set, bounded design, assumed mixture-integrability certificate or assumed mixture Supermartingale conclusion is required.

dependency_graph: Actual deterministic-parameter exponential integrability and CE bounds -> constant normalized factor; finite predictable simple coefficients use only finitely many CE events.

Finite-valued approximation of a predictable coefficient -> pointwise exponential convergence; nonnegative Fatou on each conditioning event -> actual integrability and eventwise integral budget -> actual CE comparison under trim.
Bounded predictable weight pullout -> weighted integral budget; truncation min(W,n) and nonnegative Fatou -> unbounded nonnegative integrable weights with derived product integrability.
Literal regression product recurrence + predictable scalar projection + previous wealth adapted/integrable -> actual one-step set-integral inequality -> actual Supermartingale.
Exact finite product exponent sum + literal responseVector and designGram_quadratic -> exact source score/Gram exponential identity for nonzero sigma.

Nonnegative family expectation budgets<=1 -> actual product-measure integrability by integrable_prod_iff; joint measurability and Fubini on conditioning-event restrictions -> actual probability-mixture Supermartingale.

obligations.item: Ordinary CE input is not vacuous
obligations.evidence: ConditionalSubgaussian contains ambient measurability of X and explicit Integrable(exp(hX)) for each h, in addition to the actual ordinary CE inequality. The explicit integrability prevents totalized CE from satisfying the assumption vacuously.

condExp_le is forall h, AE omega, with h outside AE. SimpleFunc induction invokes finitely many bounds at a time. Approximation and Fatou then work separately on each conditioning-measurable event. No uncountable common null-set interchange or conditional-distribution representation is used.

SimpleFunc.approxOn is constructed in the preaction measurable space; pointwise convergence is stated at every omega. factor_measurable uses the actual ambient X and the sigma inclusion. Positivity of the exponential supplies Fatou nonnegativity.

nonnegative_limit_budget proves a finite ofReal lintegral bound, then derives HasFiniteIntegral and Bochner integrability before converting back to real integrals. The method does not assume domination of unbounded coefficients or weighted products.

bounded_weight_factor first establishes actual product L1 from a bounded measurable weight. weighted_factor uses min(W,n), proves its bound/integrability and pointwise eventual agreement, and applies nonnegative Fatou. W is explicitly nonnegative and integrable; no sign-changing extension is claimed.
projection is F_n-measurable; xi_n is F_(n+1)-measurable. The wealth product through n is F_n-measurable. Only then is the weighted conditional budget applied at the next factor.

exponentialProcess is a literal finite product of normalized factors. Its exact exponential formula is derived with sigma!=0, finite sum algebra, responseVector and the actual Gram quadratic identity. No desired MGF or determinant expression is a field.

mixture_joint_integrable derives each family expectation<=1 from actual Supermartingale setIntegral_le and actual initial value1, uses nonnegativity to identify the norm integral, then proves product L1 by integrable_prod_iff. Both measures are actual probabilities.

probabilityMixture_supermartingale derives strong adaptedness by actual joint measurability. Restrictions to each conditioning event inherit joint L1 by measure monotonicity. Fubini swaps both integrals, and the actual family set-integral inequality gives the mixture inequality.

The unpredictable-coefficient and unpredictable-design controls first construct genuine conditional noise hypotheses on a fair Bernoulli experiment and then show the post-response choice has expected normalized factor exp(1/2)>1. The mass-two mixing control rejects false M0=1 for an actual unnormalized measure. All three reviewer reruns yield exactly one intended unsolved False.

execution_evidence.scope: Reviewer independently reran both isolated compiles, all37 named axioms, arbitrary-space signatures and all3 semantic controls. Author individual kernel-replay markers were inspected; not independently repeated.

strongest_safe_statement: Both actual helper chains are supported under their written hypotheses, including arbitrary unbounded predictable coefficients/weights and the derived nonnegative probability-mixture Supermartingale.
